title: Client Relationship Manager
description:
Summary
The Client Relationship Manager is the primary customer contact for Workiva Managed Services and is responsible for customer activities from the initial stages of onboarding to project delivery. The Client Relationship Manager will have an understanding of each customer's project requirements and act as a consultant to determine how the various features can meet their needs. The Client Relationship Manager will partner with other Workiva teams on initiatives that address customer needs. Produce quality work with support to analyze and provide data to inform decision-making. Leads self in a well-structured environment: Delivers multiple tasks or processes

What You’ll Do

• Deliver high-quality service and support throughout the completion of the Managed Services project

• Serve as primary customer contact for Workiva products and services

• Assist Customer & Partner Experience Team on ancillary projects, as needed

• Works to a weekly horizon. Recognizes and acts on inconsistencies in data or results.

• Resolve moderate customer issues and escalate more complex issues while remaining accountable to customers

• Manage a book of business, supporting them through regular checkpoints and developing meaningful relationships representing Workiva platform offerings to our clients

• Obtain feedback from clients and provide it to necessary internal departments, including sales, marketing, and research & development

• Train customers on how to use the Workiva platform to achieve customer technology goals and objectives through shared best practices

• Use customer management tools to track customer communication, issues, and metrics

• Design and execute onboarding project plans for Capital Markets customers.

• Coordinate and review the filing process for Capital Markets customers

• 24/7 dedication to Working Group (issuer counsel, underwriter counsel, bankers, auditors, consultants, and customer) throughout the completion of the project

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications

• Undergraduate Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience in a related field.

• 2+ years (s) of Customer Service, Account Management, Project Management, or equivalent experience in roles with a strong focus on communication and influencing others.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in the accounting/finance industry

• Familiarity with Capital Markets processes and filings

• Self-motivated with a strong propensity for action, results, and continuous improvement

• Ability to work successfully in a high-energy, fast-paced, rapidly changing environment

• Proven ability to identify customers’ needs and expectations with a timely and effective customer service response

• Competency in using the Workiva platform, Google Drive, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Salesforce, and Gainsight

• Project management and organizational skills to meet established timelines

• Communication, influence, & presentation skills with a high level of comfort in delivering consultative recommendations

Travel Requirements and Working Conditions

• Minimal travel for customer and internal meetings

• Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely and not in a Workiva office

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

title: Principal Identity and Access Management Consultant
description:
Join the Intelance associate panel. The first engagement is expected to start in November 2026, subject to client approval.
Intelance is a UK advisory firm working on technology governance, cyber security and data governance. We are looking for a senior identity and access specialist to lead access governance work for a UK regulated investment firm. You will be the person the client works with day to day, backed by an Intelance engagement partner.
Tasks

Lead the client relationship day to day, including the steering committee and weekly updates.
Turn an agreed access design into a working plan with the client's system owners, and keep it on track.
Own the single record of who can see which client information, and how it is kept up to date.
Redesign how access is given, changed and removed when people join, move or leave, across Microsoft 365, SharePoint, a CRM and a cloud data platform.
Run sessions with senior business owners to confirm access rules and exceptions.
Guide the choice of an identity governance tool, if the client goes ahead.
Write short, plain English documents that senior people outside technology can act on.

Requirements

12 years or more in identity and access management, with at least 5 years leading client or programme work.
You have led access governance or role based access work in financial services, ideally asset management, wealth or private markets.
Hands on experience of at least one identity governance tool, such as SailPoint, Saviynt, Omada or Microsoft Entra ID Governance.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365, SharePoint permissions and Entra ID.
Confident with senior people, including general counsel, heads of technology and partners.
You write short, clear documents without jargon.
Right to work in the UK, and able to work through your own limited company.

Ready to make a difference?

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Project Management-Power Delivery to lead and grow our Project Management Organization within the Grid Engineering & Analytics team. In this leadership role, you will be responsible for overseeing a team of project managers, strengthening project delivery practices, driving portfolio performance, and ensuring the successful execution of engineering and consulting projects serving utility clients nationwide.

You will work closely with engineering leaders, project managers, business development professionals, clients, and corporate support functions to deliver projects safely, efficiently, and profitably while supporting the continued growth of our organization. The ideal candidate combines strong project delivery expertise, people leadership, and business acumen, and measures success by how well the project managers around them perform.

Our team is passionate about re-engineering how electric utilities solve their toughest challenges. We combine innovation, technical rigor, and a client-first mindset to deliver exceptional engineering solutions across planning, design, analysis, modernization, and construction support services. This role plays a critical part in developing project management talent, improving project performance, and ensuring consistent execution across a diverse portfolio of utility projects.

• Natural coach and mentor who develops project managers through training, honest performance feedback, and real career paths, and who builds a culture of accountability, collaboration, and client service around them.

• Highly organized and proactive, with the ability to identify project risks, resource constraints, and delivery challenges before they impact clients or business performance.

• Establish and maintain engineering project management standards, governance processes, tools, and best practices that promote consistent project execution and predictable delivery outcomes.

title: KIP Spring 2027 - Government Affairs Intern - Media Research Center
tags: Part Time or Full Time Internship
description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

Please note that all Koch Internship Program interns MUST be available every other Thursday from 1-4:00 PM ET for virtual professional development training AND the in-person summit at Stand Together's Headquarters in Arlington, VA June 3-4.
 
 
About Media Research Center:
 
The Media Research Center (MRC) is America’s premier media watchdog. Since 1987, MRC has exposed left-wing bias in news and pop culture, defended free speech, and fought Big Tech censorship of conservatives. With powerful tools like its TV news archive and CensorTrack database, MRC provides hard evidence of bias and censorship. We educate the public and shape the national conversation across platforms that generate over 500 million weekly impressions.
 
About the role 
The Media Research Center is seeking an Government Affairs Intern to support our coalition relations, outreach, and event planning efforts. This intern will work closely with MRC’s Government Affairs team to help build relationships with partner organizations, assist with research projects, and coordinate communications and events. This role is ideal for a student or recent graduate who is passionate about conservative values and eager to gain firsthand experience in political outreach and coalition-building.
 
The Government Affairs Intern will be a key contributor to several high-impact initiatives and will collaborate with multiple departments across the organization. The role is based at MRC’s headquarters and is in-person only.
 
This internship is designed for students and recent graduates. The position is in-person only at MRC headquarters; remote work is not available.
 

Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. Our admissions office treats all program participants and applicants with honesty, dignity, respect and sensitivity. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of color, race, religion, religious creed, sex, gender or gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, ethnicity, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy (including medical needs which may arise from pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), military and veteran status, genetic information, marital or familial status, political affiliation, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

title: Director, Enterprise Sales
description:
About Channel Fusion
Founded more than 20 years ago, Channel Fusion provides brands and their channel partners with an ecosystem of channel marketing technologies, solutions and services. By coupling innovative technologies, industry expertise and a relentless customer-focused support team, we provide a unique combination of platforms, products and people.

Our purpose is simple: inspire our clients to achieve their desired outcomes by transforming channel marketing into impactful business results. We do this by ensuring an understanding of your desired outcomes first and then deploying tailored solutions using a disciplined process to achieve those outcomes.
Once a program is operational, our support team of Fusers becomes an extension of your brand to ensure your channel partners have an optimal customer experience while maximizing their marketing investment in your brand. Our account leadership teams stay involved every step of the way to ensure programs continue to exceed expectations and drive your desired outcomes.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Senior outbound hunter. Net-new enterprise revenue. Full cycle.
You will target Fortune 1000 brands with established dealer or distributor networks. You will live on the phone, in the inbox, and at the right industry events. You will build a book of business from cold and own it through close.
If you have not personally generated pipeline from cold to closed in the last 12 months, this is not for you.
Channel Fusion has run channel marketing programs for enterprise clients for over 25 years. We are in mid-transition from a services company to a product-led, AI-fueled platform business. The right hunter joins right now, while the platform is fresh and the field is still wide open.
What you’ll walk into:

• A proven services portfolio with named enterprise logos and live case studies.

• An emerging product platform (EngageHQ) with AI-enabled channel analytics competitors do not have yet.

• A lean leadership team actively rebuilding GTM around outbound and platform monetization.

• Enterprise AI rolled out across the company, with internal sales agents purpose-built for prospect research, deal acceleration, and tailored response generation.

You’re not joining a sleep mid-market shop. You are joining a real channel marketing infrastructure company at the exact moment it begins a new phase of hockey stick growth.
WHAT YOU OWN

•
Outbound Net-New Revenue. You build the pipeline. Prospecting, multichannel outreach, intent-driven targeting, conference work, executive networking, and partnership-sourced opportunities. The current outbound motion is light. You will define it.

•
Full Sales Cycle. First touch to signed MSA. Discovery, demo, proposal, pricing, procurement, legal.Target ACV $200K to $500K. Target cycle reduction to six to nine months.Multi-year contracts preferred.

•
Forecast Discipline. HubSpot is the source of truth. Weekly pipeline reviews. Accurate stage progression. No happy ears.

•
Solutions Mapping. You match the right Engage modules and services to the prospect’s actual problem. You do not pitch the catalog. You diagnose, prescribe, and be client advocate until handover.

•
Industry Coverage. Primary verticals: automotive OEMS, powersports, insurance carriers, industrial manufacturing, construction materials, and other F1000 brands with established dealer or distributor networks.

•
Competitive Positioning. You know the channel marketing and MarTech landscape cold. You know where Channel Fusion wins, where we differentiate, and where we walk.

WHAT YOU DO NOT OWN
This is a focused hunter role. Scope clarity matters.

•
Inbound Demand. The Director of Sales & Marketing owns inbound. You own outbound. Clean split, no overlap.

•
RFP Responses. The Director of Sales & Marketing owns the RFP process. You contribute deal context, pricing input, prospect intel, and live in the room on your accounts. You do not write the RFP but will contribute to shaping every response.

•
Marketing.

title: Growth Engineer Intern
description:
About Snezzi

We help brands show up in AI answers. End to end.
When someone asks ChatGPT "which probiotic should I buy for my dog" or Perplexity "best whatsapp automation tool," we make sure our clients are the ones being recommended. Not through hacks. Through real content, technical fixes, backlinks, and measurement.
Founded by three operators who've built and exited bootstrapped companies before.
We're AI-first internally. Heavy use of agents and n8n workflows across content, technical SEO, and delivery.
The Role
Insights are cheap. Execution is the whole game.
Every client we sign comes with a stack of work waiting to be done. Content gaps to close. Schema to fix. Pages to publish. Backlinks to chase. Programmatic templates to roll out. Our platform tells us exactly what to do for each brand. Someone still has to do it. That's you.
But doing it once is not enough. We serve multiple brands with a small team. So the second half of the role is leverage. Every time you ship something manually, you should be asking what would let the next person ship it in half the time. That answer usually looks like an n8n workflow, an AI agent, or a small script that turns a 3-hour task into a 10-minute one.
If you like shipping, and you like building the thing that lets you ship more, this role fits.
What you'll actually do

• Ship technical SEO fixes on Shopify and WordPress: metadata, schema, FAQs, internal linking, site structure

• Turn prompt insights into content. Briefs, publishing, internal linking, distribution

• Run backlink outreach against the opportunities the platform surfaces

• Build programmatic pages that earn citations: comparisons, best-of, use case, prompt-based

• Build n8n agents and workflows that scale every part of delivery: content pipelines, outreach, publishing, reporting

• Own outcomes on live client accounts. Be on calls when it matters

• Catch manual work before it becomes a habit. Automate it

You're a fit if

• You ship. Credentials are nice. Output matters more

• You can code enough to glue things together. Python or JS. APIs don't scare you

• n8n, Zapier, Make, or similar are familiar. Or you'll learn one over a weekend

• You write like a human. Short. Direct. No "leveraging synergies"

• You communicate well. Written and verbal. You'll be on client calls, in Slack threads, and writing briefs people have to act on

• You have opinions on how AI search works and how it's changing

• Bonus: prior SEO, content, growth, or AI agent work

You're not a fit if

• You need a detailed brief before you move

• You want to specialize narrowly from day one

• You think SEO is dead or that GEO is a gimmick

• You want the strategist title without the execution

What you get

• Direct work with three second-time founders. No layers

• Live client accounts from week one. Outcomes you can point to

• Range: content, technical SEO, AI engineering, automation. Six months of compounding skill

• PPO on the table for the right person

• Remote, India-based. We care about what ships, not where you sit

About the Role

NETGEAR is looking for a highly skilled, customer-focused L3 Technical Support Engineer to join our growing Enterprise Networking and AV technical support team. This is a remote position based in Canada, with a preference for candidates in British Columbia. You'll work hours that line up with Pacific Time to support our North America customers.

You'll be the escalation point for L1 and L2 support. Working with our engineering teams, you'll resolve complex networking and AV-over-IP issues for enterprise customers, MSPs, and integrators. You'll support NETGEAR's switches, WiFi access points, security gateways, and network management solutions, both cloud and on-premises. In this post-sales role, you'll represent NETGEAR to our customers, bringing strong technical skills and excellent customer management to a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Serve as the technical escalation point for Enterprise Networking and AV customers, working with them directly by phone whenever possible

- Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues involving:

- Layer 2 switching and Layer 3 routing

- QoS, IGMP, and STP

- Network and AV-over-IP hardware

- Wireless networking

- AV protocols and interoperability (Dante, NDI, AES67, and others)

- Cloud-based and on-premises management platforms

- Work with engineering and product teams to resolve complex issues and bugs, and share feedback that improves the customer experience

- Replicate issues and validate fixes hands-on in lab environments

- Document solutions, root causes, and workarounds in the knowledge base

- Stay current on emerging networking and AV technologies, including NETGEAR product roadmaps and firmware updates

- Contribute to proactive support work, such as support guides, training for lower-tier support teams, and customer-facing webinars and documentation

What You Bring

- 4+ years of experience in customer-facing technical support, network operations, or field support, ideally in enterprise or AV-over-IP switching environments

- Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to customers at any level of technical expertise

- Extensive knowledge of networking protocols and topologies

- Hands-on expertise with:

- VLANs, QoS, STP/RSTP, and Ethernet switching protocols

- Wireless networking deployment and troubleshooting

- Routing protocols and troubleshooting

- IGMP Snooping, Querier, and multicast traffic optimization

- CLI troubleshooting tools, port mirroring, and packet capture analysis

- Strong working knowledge of Wireshark

- Experience supporting or deploying NETGEAR switches or similar platforms (Cisco, Extreme, Aruba)

- Strong skills with technical documentation, ticketing systems, and remote diagnostic tools

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with ProAV systems and tools such as Dante Controller, Q-SYS, NDI Studio Monitor, AMX, or Crestron NVX

- Experience supporting AV system integrators, event production, or ProAV deployments

- Industry certifications such as NETGEAR Certified, CCNA, CWNA, Dante Level 2+, or AVIXA CTS

- A track record of working remotely and independently

Who You Are

- A confident problem solver who handles escalations calmly and professionally

- Committed to customer satisfaction, with a consultative approach

- A clear, effective communicator with customers, partners, and internal teams

- Detail-oriented, with strong organization and documentation habits

- Collaborative across Support, Engineering, and Product teams

- Flexible with your hours when global customers need support

Company Statement/Values:  

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect.

title: Senior Corporate Enterprise Platform Engineer, Windows
description:
Role Description

As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will own and improve Dropbox’s Windows endpoint platform. You will bring deep Windows and Intune expertise, make patching and application delivery more reliable, and build automation that reduces recurring work for the team.

This is a hands-on role combining Windows technical ownership with the development of a more code-managed endpoint platform. You will help evaluate and adopt FleetDM, osquery, infrastructure-as-code, and GitOps practices where they improve reliability, visibility, and maintainability. You will strengthen the current environment while building and validating the path forward-not assume that replacing a tool is the answer.

You will work with CorpInfra, IAM, Security, and support teams to make practical technical decisions, lead multi-phase improvements, and clarify ownership. You will also mentor teammates through pairing, code review, and shared operational practices. This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-management position.

Responsibilities

• Own endpoint reliability and lifecycle management. Improve provisioning, application delivery, updates, security configuration, and troubleshooting across the endpoint environment.

• Make patching predictable and safe. Strengthen update workflows through testing, controlled rollouts, and remediation.

• Make fleet health trustworthy and actionable. Improve reporting on device health, patching, and configuration, with clear ownership for resolving issues.

• Build maintainable automation. Turn recurring work into reliable, tested workflows that other engineers can operate.

• Advance code-managed endpoint operations. Adopt tools and practices that improve configuration management, validation, and deployment.

• Lead cross-functional platform improvements. Define practical roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and balance security, reliability, employee experience, and team capacity.

• Strengthen the team’s capability. Mentor teammates, review code and designs, and document reusable practices that improve coverage across the endpoint team.

Requirements

• Significant experience engineering and operating Windows endpoint environments, with personal ownership beyond ticket handling or routine console administration.

• Deep hands-on Intune experience across device lifecycle, configuration and compliance policies, application management, update workflows, and relevant Entra ID dependencies.

• Strong Windows troubleshooting skills across operating-system behavior, services, logs, networking, certificates, identity, and security controls. Able to distinguish reported management status from actual endpoint health.

• Recent ownership of Windows and third-party application patching, including staged deployment, user-impact validation, failed-device handling, exceptions, and recovery.

• Strong practical PowerShell skills and familiarity with at least one additional programming language, such as Python, Go, or C#. Experience building and maintaining production automation or systems integrations.

• Demonstrated use of version control, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for operational changes. Able to explain safe retries, failure handling, secrets management, and configuration drift.

• Ability to independently define and deliver multi-phase work, prioritize under ambiguity, partner across teams, and mentor other engineers.

• Clear written and verbal communication, including concise technical decisions, incident updates, runbooks, and effective asynchronous collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications

• Production experience with FleetDM on Windows , including agent operations, policies, queries, targeting, API integrations, or configuration managed through GitOps.

• Practical osquery and SQL experience for endpoint inventory, health, or security use cases, including query validation, performance considerations, and handling stale or missing results.

title: Associate Strategy Consultant / Program Manager
description:
About the engagement:
Apogee Global RMS is delivering a focused, strategy engagement to help a leading global executive institution sharpen its competitive position and chart a three-to-five-year growth strategy. The work spans a competitive market analysis, a three-region assessment (North America, Europe, and Asia), an organizational-structure and resource review, and a board-ready strategy delivered to institutional leadership.
The engagement is led personally by the firm's Founder & Principal Advisor. We are seeking one capable, versatile professional to combine two supporting functions - hands-on strategy analysis and engagement program management - into a single role working directly alongside the Engagement Lead.
Role overview:
This is a dual role. Roughly three-quarters of your time is spent as an Associate Strategy Consultant - carrying a substantial share of the research, analysis, and drafting under the Lead's direction - and the balance as the engagement's Program Manager, owning the schedule, milestones, and coordination that keep a compressed 12-week engagement on track. You will own defined pieces of work end-to-end, with clear direction and review at each milestone.
Key responsibilities:
Strategy & analysis (Associate Strategy Consultant):

• Support stakeholder interviews during the Week 1 Phoenix onsite; capture, synthesize, and circulate findings.

• Design, administer, and analyze the stakeholder/market survey.

• Conduct secondary market and competitive research; build the current-state baseline.

• Contribute to the three-region assessment and the organizational-structure review.

• Draft findings, regional memos, and sections of the strategy document for the Lead's review and authorship.

• Prepare board-ready materials for the executive outbrief.

Program management:

• Own the engagement schedule and workplan across the twelve weeks and four phases (Discover, Diagnose, Design, Deliver).

• Track progress against the three client milestones - Current Market Review (~Week 4), Draft Strategy (~Week 10), and Final Delivery (~Week 12) - and flag risks early.

• Maintain action logs, status reporting, and version control; manage the engagement's document/data room.

• Coordinate working sessions, the mid-point review (~Week 7), and onsite logistics for both Phoenix trips.

Requirements
Required qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree and 2-4 years (or equivalent) in strategy, management consulting, corporate strategy, or a comparable analytical role.

• Strong research, quantitative analysis, and business-writing skills; able to produce first drafts with light direction.

• Demonstrated project or program coordination - scheduling, milestone tracking, and stakeholder communication.

• Poised and credible in client-facing and executive settings.

• Highly organized, reliable, and self-directed under a compressed timeline.

• Proficiency with standard analysis and productivity tools (spreadsheets, slides, documents).

• Availability of ~15-20 hours per week for the full 12 weeks, and ability to travel to Phoenix twice.

Preferred qualifications:

• Exposure to higher education or executive global-market strategy, or go-to-market work.

• Familiarity with strategy frameworks and organizational assessment.

• Survey design and analysis experience.

• Formal project-management training (e.g., PMP or coursework) is a plus but not required.

title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - La Crosse
description:
Job Title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - La Crosse
Job Location: Work at Home, Wisconsin, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Per diem employees qualify for:

• Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours
12

title: International Category Manager (Associate experience) - (M/F/X)
locationText: Berlin, Berlin, Germany; Paris, Paris, France
description:
The Role : What’s in the Box

We are looking for a talented Category Manager to become part of our European Strategic Sourcing Team. Your role will involve contributing to the development and implementation of category strategies spanning multiple markets across Europe. 

As an International Category Manager, you will collaborate closely with both local and global stakeholders and help ensure we source high-quality ingredients and packaging at the best costs.

This position can be based in Paris or Berlin and we have openings across several categories, including Protein; Produce, Herbs and Fruits; Grocery & Dairy; and Packaging. 

You will be able to tell us which categories interest you most in your application, and we will match you to the best fit.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don't "tick all the boxes" but think you'd thrive in this role, we would like to learn more about you.

What You'll Do : The Recipe

• Shape the category strategy: Help build and roll out category strategies across European markets, aligned with our business objectives and supply chain needs, working hand in hand with senior team members.

• Own supplier relationships and negotiations: Manage key supplier relationships across markets and lead negotiations within your scope to secure the best possible terms, working independently and constructively with internal and external stakeholders.

• Drive savings: Identify and deliver cost reduction opportunities by leveraging volumes and improving processes across markets.

• Build the numbers behind every decision: Develop robust cost models, run make-or-buy analyses and monitor key commodity prices, so we pay fair prices and make well-informed sourcing decisions.

• Stay ahead of the market: Forecast future cost pricing using data, industry knowledge and Generative AI tools, track market trends, regulatory changes and emerging technologies, and challenge the status quo with ideas to improve our processes.

• Lead projects and grow others: Drive short-term procurement projects, support long-term initiatives with cross-functional teams, solve non-routine topics autonomously (aligning regularly with your manager on priorities), and mentor junior team members, interns and working students.

What You'll Bring : 

• Bachelor's or master's degree from a top-tier college or university, preferably in business, engineering, supply chain, finance, or science.

• Minimum of 3 years of strategic procurement or production experience, preferably in the food or food-packaging industry, or alternatively as a management consultant with a focus on operations.

• Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take initiative, work independently, and drive implementation.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work successfully in flexible team structures around the world.

• Strong organizational and project management skills with a track record of successfully implementing cross-functional projects.

• Capability to excel in flexible global team structures amid a reasonable degree of uncertainty.

• Comfortable contributing to and managing projects, including developing new processes, SLAs, and KPIs.

• Strong at devising creative solutions to supply issues, as well as designing, communicating, and executing action plans for effective resolution.

• Convincing track record of successful negotiations with external partners.

• Strong quantitative and analytical skills.

• Excellent English proficiency is required, another European language is a plus.

• Willingness to travel internationally up to 25% of the time.

What we offer: The Toppings

• The chance to have a serious impact role on one of the most exciting foodtech companies in Europe

• A vibrant & international environment with a great culture & DNA

• A guaranteed steep learning curve

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team - from Finance to HR - to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

title: Cyber Analyst, Digital Forensics Incident Response
description:

At-Bay is a fast-growth InsurSec company (Insurance x Cybersecurity) on a mission to bring innovative products to the market that help protect small businesses from digital risks. As an InsurSec provider, we uniquely combine insurance with mission-critical security technologies, threat intelligence, and human expertise, to bridge the critical security capability gap that exists among SMBs in the community. We believe InsurSec is an $80B market opportunity and we are excited to expand our DFIR team in order to help expand our reach and influence in the business and security community, of which we serve 35,000 customers.
The Role:

• Forensically sound collection, transmission, and storage of digital evidence

• Analysis of digital evidence to identify indicators of compromise and adversary activity

• Development of incident timelines and theories of compromise

• Identification of incident root causes

• Participation in threat actor negotiations as necessary (e.g., ransom negotiations, etc.)

• Participation in incident recovery (e.g., restoration of data from backups, reimaging workstations and servers, rebuilding network infrastructure, etc.) activities as necessary

• Development and delivery of incident reports to document key incident details for engagement stakeholders including executive leaders for insureds, breach coach attorneys, and At-Bay claims management staff as necessary

• Development and delivery of recommendations to mitigate the risk of future incidents for impacted insureds

• Development and delivery of incident response training and simulations for targeted insureds

Key skills:

• Previous digital forensics and incident response experience

• Strong oral and written communication skills

• Previous hands-on experience performing digital forensics and incident response, including several of the following:

• Business Email Compromise

• Ransomware

• Digital evidence collection and analysis

• Development and analysis of cyber threat intelligence

• Leadership of or participation in investigations involving digital evidence

• Intrusion detection / cyber threat hunting

• Malware analysis

• Incident recovery activities such as restoration of data from backups, operation of decryptor tools, etc.

• Previous hands-on experience working in information technology operations (e.g., Network Operations Center, Security Operations Center, Incident Response Team, etc.)

Minimum requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, incident response, incident recovery, or another security discipline

• Willingness to travel as needed to perform job functions

Preferred requirements:

• Significant undergraduate or graduate coursework in computer science, computer engineering, information systems, or cybersecurity

• Previous background in law enforcement or government/military with experience leading complex technical investigations

• Knowledge of cloud environments, including knowledge of cloud security products and services offered by major cloud service providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google)

• Experience in a top-10 cyber consulting firm or leading DFIR provider preferred

• One or more industry cybersecurity certifications (e.g., GCIH, Security+, CISSP, etc.)

Work location:

• USA, Nationwide

title: Senior Federal Contracts and Subcontracts Management Consultant
description:
Greenberg-Larraby, Inc. (GLI) is seeking a Senior Federal Contract Management Consultant to enhance our contracting operations. In this role, you will leverage your extensive experience in federal contract management to provide strategic support and insights that will drive compliance and performance across our federal contracts. Your expertise will play a key role in developing best practices and ensuring that contracts align with GLI’s business objectives.
This position is to start as part- time as needed and can grow into a more full -time opportunity as the business grows and business needs. This is a full remote position.
Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and manage the entire lifecycle of federal contracts, from negotiation to execution and compliance review.

• Develop and implement effective contract management processes, ensuring proper risk assessments and mitigation strategies.

• Advise and collaborate with internal stakeholders on contract terms, compliance matters, and performance metrics.

• Conduct thorough contract analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

• Provide training and mentorship to junior contract staff to build stronger contract management capabilities.

• Monitor changes in federal regulations and policies and assess their impact on existing contracts.

• Prepare and present reports to senior management regarding contract status and compliance-related issues.

Requirements
Qualifications:

• 10+ years of experience in federal government contract management supporting IDIQ, Task Order, and Subcontract execution under large federal vehicles (VA, DoD, HHS, DHS preferred).

• Demonstrated expertise interpreting and enforcing FAR Part 16 (IDIQ), FAR Part 42 (Prime/Sub oversight), and FAR Changes clauses as they apply to Task Orders and subcontractor rights.

• Expertise in IDIQ task order environments and traditional federal set-aside contracting (WOSB, HUBZone, and 8(a) , and a clear understanding of how primes and subcontractors operate differently within each structure.

• Deep working knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), DFARS where applicable, and the practical application of these regulations to IDIQ task orders, set-aside vehicles (WOSB, HUBZone, 8(a), SDVOSB), and subcontractor management in a prime/sub environment is required.

• Direct experience working for or advising Prime contractors and subcontractors on execution of awarded Task Orders.

• Experience with resolving Prime/Subcontractor performance, scope, and execution conflicts.

• Deep working knowledge of how credentialing, onboarding, and security clearance timelines intersect with contractual obligations on healthcare and professional services contracts.

• Strong ability to review existing subcontract language and identify risk, leverage points, and enforcement mechanisms .

• Experience advising small businesses and federal subcontractors and prime positioning.

• Exceptional analytical and writing skills with the ability to draft clear contractual position statements and executive-level communications .

• Ability to provide practical, actionable guidance with deep understanding of FAR regulations within large multi-year and multi-billion dollar contracts.

• Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)

title: Event Project Manager
description:
Meeting Tomorrow is a 23-year-old company with a growing team of 90 talented, friendly people. We’re headquartered in Chicago, with about 80% of our team working remotely in cities across the country.
We are a full-service event agency with three core divisions: planning, production, and creative. We plan and produce corporate events of every shape and size, partnering with clients that include Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations across a wide array of industries.
We’re known for our exceptional customer experience, our collaborative culture, and our can-do spirit. Our culture has earned us recognition as a Top 20 Inspiring Workplace in North America, as well as the Events Industry Council's Social Impact Award. We offer great benefits, the best coworkers you’ll find anywhere, and the opportunity to work in a dynamic, team-oriented environment. We can’t wait to meet you!

The Opportunity
The Event Project Manager is responsible for managing the complex lifecycle of AV production and creative design projects for our clients' most important events.
This person will work with clients across the Tech, Finance, Pharma, and Non-Profit spaces, serving as the face of Meeting Tomorrow throughout the event execution process. You aren't just managing tasks; you are a consultant and a brand steward for our clients’ most vital internal and client-facing events, leading the information flow across all parties. This role is highly detailed, task-oriented, and requires the executive presence to guide stakeholders throughout the whole process, ultimately ensuring the clients' vision for AV production and creative design becomes reality.
This role requires frequent to moderate onsite travel (approximately 20-30%, or 4-5 days per month).
What You'll Own
Audiovisual Event Project Planning: You’ll lead numerous events throughout the year, managing project scope, timelines, and budgets. You’ll guide clients through the project lifecycle, coaching them on AV Production best practices for in-person and hybrid events to ensure the execution exceeds their vision.
Communication & Decision Making: You are the client’s main point of contact and MT representative. You’ll lead the information flow between internal teams (fulfillment, creative, etc.), venues, vendors, and the client, while expertly preparing onsite staff for successful execution.
Client Relationship Building: You don’t just manage events but you build genuine connections. You’ll get to know our clients on a personal level (interests, family, life events) and bring a level of enthusiasm that drives credibility and repeat business.
Creative Deliverables Management: You’ll act as the bridge between clients and creative teams (designers, editors). You’ll manage logistics with vendors (decor, print, custom fabrication), maintain asset trackers, manage POs, and negotiate terms to be a true steward of the client’s budget.
On-Site Leadership: You’ll travel (approx. 20-30%) to be the face of MT, preparing onsite staff in partnership with Production Managers to execute flawlessly while maintaining high energy in fast-paced event environments.
What We Need
4-7+ Years of Event Industry Experience: You’ve navigated the agency or white-glove event world and have a customer-focused mindset.

title: ALD Lab - Working Student
description:
Your Role

As an ALD Lab Working Student, you will support the daily operation of our Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) tool and the relevant metrology tools in the FabONE cleanroom in Aachen.

Working alongside our ALD process engineers, you will prepare samples, perform routine thin-film characterization, and maintain accurate laboratory records. This is a hands-on opportunity to gain practical experience with semiconductor processing, metrology tools, and cleanroom operations while contributing to our ongoing research and development activities.

What You’ll Do

- Prepare samples for ALD and characterization runs.

- Handle delicate samples and cleanroom equipment in accordance with established safety and quality procedures

- Organize measurement data and prepare clear summaries of film-characterization results

- Help establish and maintain an inventory system for chemicals and precursors

What You Bring

- Current enrolment in a bachelor’s or master’s program in materials science, physics, chemistry, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or a related field, ideally in the last year.

- A basic understanding of thin-film characterization methods such as ellipsometry, Raman spectroscopy, optical microscopy or AFM

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle delicate samples accurately

- An interest in semiconductor processing and a willingness to learn cleanroom protocols

- Basic proficiency in data logging, documentation and data visualization using Excel or Python

- Good communication skills in English

- The ability to work effectively and reliably within a laboratory team

What We Offer

- Hands-on experience with ALD processes, thin-film characterization and semiconductor laboratory operations

- Practical training in cleanroom safety, sample preparation and metrology equipment

- The opportunity to work with spectroscopic ellipsometry, Raman spectroscopy, optical microscopy and AFM

- Close collaboration with experienced ALD process engineers in our FabONE facility in Aachen

- The opportunity to contribute directly to the organization and efficiency of an active research and development laboratory

title: Spanish Speaking Oncology Nurse Navigator
description:
CancerNavigator is an early-stage healthcare company (remote, headquartered in Washington, D.C.) dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.
Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief
Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.
CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. All of our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who work with members to catch cancer early, get them to fantastic experts for their care, and help them through the thousands of other problems patients and their families face.
Join us to help serve cancer patients in their hour of need.
The “Nurse Navigator” Role
Our oncology nurse navigators are the front-line of CancerNavigator ’s patient service. Nurse Navigators support patients at all parts of their journey - newly diagnosed, in active treatment, and entering remission. With more specificity, oncology nurse navigators:

• Educate cancer patients (and their families) about their diagnosis, treatment options, and provide helpful information on any related questions and concerns the patient may have

• Work closely with the researchers on our team to deliver tailored information to patients, guiding them to the centers and doctors that would be a great option for the patient’s care

• Do everything possible to address any barriers to care (e.g. registering and scheduling appointments, coordinating with their health plan or their care team, transferring records, etc.)

• Provide longitudinal support to the patient throughout their journey - helping them solve any issues related to their cancer diagnosis and care - whether connecting patients to mental health support, finding resources to ease the financial burden, arranging transportation to appointments, or answering any questions that may arise

The Requirements
The main requirement of this role is oncology nursing experience and a passion for serving cancer patients. More specifically, we are looking for someone with the following experience and qualifications:

• Ability to work Pacific hours (8am-5pm PST)

• Native Spanish Speaker

• 3+ years of oncology nursing experience

• Mastery of common navigation and care coordination issues (registration, scheduling, clinical department navigation, insurance coordination, solving coverage issues, etc.)

• Mastery of basic computer tools (Gmail, Zoom, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)

• Preferred: Oncology Certified Nurse (OCN)

Compensation and Benefits

• Starting Salary Range: $100-115k (based on skills and experience)

• Dental and Healthcare (80% employer paid), Vision Insurance (100% employer paid)

• Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

• Group Life and AD&D Insurance (involuntary with the option to buy up coverage)

• Unlimited PTO

• Remote-first work; live where you want within the continental US

• All-company on-sites 2x per year (in Washington DC and Denver)

Our Culture & Values, In Brief
We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be clearer - serve cancer patients. As the business grows, and the work becomes more complex, we need to become more, not less, committed to why we are doing this.
We have three company values, which guide our work:

•
Patients first, always: In everything we do, we put the cancer patient (and their families) first; we exist to serve them in their most urgent moments.

•
Respect for our responsibility: We strive, as a team, to respect the gravity of the responsibility we bear to patients, always acting and producing in a way that is worthy of the trust they have placed in us.

•
Kindness to and respect for others: We treat our teammates well, no exceptions. We are one team.

title: Senior Stack Scientist
description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy. As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance. Key Responsibilities Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks. Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles. Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance. Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams. Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies. Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Über uns
Lupa entwickelt ein Produkt, das eine völlig neue Kategorie schafft und das es in der Branche so noch nicht gegeben hat.

Wir sind das KI-native Betriebssystem für Tierarztpraxen und Tierhalter. Unsere intelligente All-in-one-Plattform ersetzt die fragmentierten, umständlichen Systeme, mit denen Tierarztpraxen seit Jahren arbeiten müssen. Sie vereint Terminplanung, Kundenkommunikation, klinische Dokumentation und KI-gestützte Behandlungsempfehlungen. Praxen arbeiten dadurch effizienter, Tierärzte können sich wieder auf das konzentrieren, was sie lieben, und Tierhalter sind enger mit der Gesundheit ihrer Tiere verbunden als je zuvor.

Unsere Erfolge sprechen für sich: 2023 gegründet, sind wir heute Marktführer in Großbritannien, gehören zu den 100 führenden KI-Start-ups Europas und sind in zwölf Monaten um das Zehnfache gewachsen. Unser Team zählt inzwischen 70 Mitarbeitende und wächst schnell weiter. Jetzt expandieren wir mit voller Kraft in die USA und nach Europa. Wir haben 25 Millionen US-Dollar an Finanzierung erhalten, betreuen mehr als 2,5 Millionen Haustiere auf unserer Plattform und haben ein lebendiges Büro in München. Außergewöhnliche Talente von Unternehmen wie Palantir, Google, DeepMind, BCG, Meta und AWS sind bereits Teil unseres Teams, und wir stehen erst am Anfang.

Dies ist die seltene Gelegenheit, genau zum richtigen Zeitpunkt Teil eines rasant wachsenden Unternehmens zu werden. Deshalb suchen wir außergewöhnliche Menschen, die dieses Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten möchten.

In dieser Rolle wirst du:

- Die Outbound-Akquise für Tierarztpraxen und Tierkliniken verantworten. Diese Pipeline baust du selbst auf

- Hochwertige Leads identifizieren, recherchieren und per Kaltakquise über Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn ansprechen

- Interessenten qualifizieren und Termine für unsere Account Executives vereinbaren, inklusive einer Übergabe mit allem relevanten Kontext

- Ein tiefes Verständnis für das Produkt, die Kunden und den Markt von Lupa aufbauen, damit deine Ansprache beratend ist und nicht nach Skript klingt

- Eng mit Marketing und Produkt zusammenarbeiten, um Messaging und Positionierung auf Basis deiner Erfahrungen aus der Praxis zu schärfen

- Die Pipelinedaten im CRM korrekt und aktuell halten, denn unser Team arbeitet mit sauberen Daten

- Erkenntnisse aus deinen Gesprächen mit Interessenten an das Team weitergeben und so unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie und Produktentwicklung mitgestalten

Dein Hintergrund könnte wie folgt aussehen:

- Fundierte Vertriebserfahrung als SDR, BDR oder in einer anderen Outbound-Rolle. Erfahrung in B2B SaaS oder Tech ist von Vorteil, aber auch andere Branchen sind willkommen!

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Muss

- Bereitschaft, vor Ort in unserem Büro in München zu arbeiten

- Du bist sicher in der Akquise per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn und gehst dabei beratend vor

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst den Mehrwert eines Produkts klar vermitteln, sowohl gegenüber medizinischem Fachpersonal als auch gegenüber nicht technischen Ansprechpartnern

- Sehr gute Organisation und hohe Eigenmotivation: Du behältst mehrere Interessenten und Pipelines gleichzeitig im Blick, ohne an Schwung zu verlieren

- Erfahrung mit einem CRM und ein datengetriebener Ansatz zur Verbesserung deiner Outreach-Ergebnisse sind von Vorteil

- Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Vertical SaaS oder im Umfeld professioneller Dienstleistungen ist von Vorteil

Als Person:

- Interessierst du dich ehrlich für die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden und willst sie lösen, anstatt nur eine Anrufquote zu erfüllen

- Bist du hungrig auf Wachstum und bereit, alles für deinen Erfolg zu geben

- Bist du belastbar: Absagen bringen dich nicht aus der Ruhe, sie machen dich besser

- Möchtest du dich in eine Closing-Rolle entwickeln und siehst die SDR-Position als Sprungbrett, nicht als Endstation

- Freust du dich darauf, vor Ort in unserem Büro in München zu arbeiten, mit gelegentlichen Reisen zu unserem Hauptsitz

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings including GD&T

As a Platform Engineer focused on Security & Compliance, you own how we prove that trust, and you do it like an engineer, not an administrator.

As we move up-market into banking and regulated industries, a SOC 2 report, an ISO 27001 certificate, and a credible answer to “how do you protect our data” increasingly decide whether a deal closes. This is a hands-on DevSecOps role inside our Platform Engineering team. You’ll own our compliance program end to end, but you’ll run it from a terminal. You’ll turn control requirements into Terraform, CI checks, and custom tests, so controls stay green without anyone chasing screenshots. It’s not a pure cybersecurity or policy role. You’ll write code and work on the platform alongside the rest of the team.

What you’ll do

- Own our compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, and DORA) and run audit cycles from evidence-gathering to the audit room

- Run our Vanta instance and automate it: build custom tests in Go or Python, automate evidence collection, and wire controls into Terraform and GitHub Actions so drift is caught in a PR, not an audit

- Implement the technical measures behind our security policies across GCP, AWS, and Azure, including access management and reviews, logging, secrets, and hardening

- Own security questionnaires and our trust center, and rebuild the answer library so a bank’s 300-question questionnaire takes days, not weeks

- Run vendor security reviews and the data-protection assessments that come with them (DPIAs, LIAs, TRIAs), and keep our risk register honest

- Pitch in on platform and reliability work with the rest of the team

What you’ll bring

- A background in platform, DevOps, cloud, or security engineering. You’ve built and run infrastructure, not just audited it

- Experience owning or heavily supporting a SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 program, and the ability to turn a control requirement into concrete technical tasks

- Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, ideally GCP (strong AWS or Azure experience also works)

- Production experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD, and enough Go or Python to build the automation this role needs

- Experience with a GRC automation platform such as Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe (Vanta a strong plus), and a firm preference for automating evidence over collecting it by hand

- Clear, persuasive writing: questionnaire answers an enterprise security team trusts, and documentation an auditor accepts the first time

- The drive to get things to closure, including chasing control owners across engineering, IT, HR, and legal

Bonus points for

- ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor, CISA, Security+, CISM, or CISSP

- Supporting compliance for financial-services or other regulated customers

- Vendor-risk (TPRM) experience

Our stack, and why

We use Vanta for compliance automation, because evidence should come from systems, not screenshots. Our infrastructure spans Google Cloud, AWS, and Azure because our customers run on all three, and our workloads run on Kubernetes across GKE, EKS, and AKS. Everything is defined in Terraform and shipped through GitHub Actions, so controls, evidence, and enforcement live in code you can read, query, and test. We write internal tooling and custom tests in Go and Python. Where the automation isn’t there yet, you build it.

Why Validio

Founded in Sweden in 2019, we’re trusted by data-driven enterprises like Nordea, Canva, Truecaller, Traveloka, and Deutsche Glasfaser. We raised a $30M Series A this year and grew ARR 800% in twelve months as enterprises got serious about making their data AI-ready. We’re 35 people today and growing fast across Sweden, London, New York, and Amsterdam. This role is hybrid, and we expect you to work from our Stockholm office at least a couple of days

title: Senior AI Product Manager (Context Engineering)
description:
About the Team/Role:

At WEX, context engineering is the discipline of turning collective company knowledge, operational reality, and business logic into trusted, timely, and permission-aware context for AI agents. As a Senior AI Product Manager (Context Engineering), you will own the enterprise context layer that powers WEX's global fleet of AI agents. In this hands-on builder role within our Data, AI, Risk & Product organization, you will bridge unstructured knowledge, governed semantic data, and agent execution workflows, partnering directly with global engineering, data, and business teams to ensure every AI action is grounded, authorized, and accurate.

How you’ll make an impact:

•
Strategy & Portfolio: Partner with global product, engineering, and business leaders to prioritize high-value context initiatives, sequencing workflows based on business impact, agent demand, source readiness, and risk.

•
Governed Semantic Layer & NL-to-SQL: Own the semantic object roadmap for core enterprise entities (e.g., accounts, claims, plans), defining certified measures, join graphs, and Row-Level Security (RLS) to replace raw schema reasoning and eliminate hallucinations.

•
Retrieval & Grounding: Establish enterprise standards for federated ingestion, chunking, caching, metadata, and citation enforcement, consolidating legacy knowledge APIs into unified, multi-tenant interfaces.

•
Workflow Context Packs: Design and deliver production-ready context packs for critical operational workflows and SOPs, partnering directly with agent teams to inspect retrieval traces, debug failures, and optimize context consumption.

•
Quality & Benchmarks: Build and run rigorous evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, error taxonomies, and go/no-go quality gates to benchmark retrieval relevance, query precision, and agent containment.

•
Governance & Value Realization: Embed auditability, data lineage, least-privilege access, and responsible AI guardrails into the context layer by design, tracking ROI through API cost reduction, task resolution lift, and operational risk mitigation.

Experience you’ll bring:

•
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

•
Experience: Senior-level Product Management experience owning data platforms, enterprise search/retrieval systems, semantic layers, API products, or internal developer platforms consumed by engineering teams.

•
Technical Skills: Deep understanding of applied generative AI and agentic systems, including advanced RAG, embeddings, chunking, metadata management, grounding, and context window assembly.

•
Data Modeling & SQL: Strong experience working with structured enterprise data, relational models, certified metrics, and the failure modes of natural-language querying over raw database schemas.

•
Hands-on Technical Depth: Demonstrated comfort working directly with technical artifacts-inspecting retrieval traces, reading SQL query plans, reviewing JSON/YAML configurations, and executing API calls.

•
AI Evaluation & Benchmarking: Proven track record of designing and running evaluation harnesses, golden benchmark datasets, error taxonomies, and quantitative quality gates.

•
Security & Governance: Solid working knowledge of enterprise controls, including authentication/identity, tenant isolation, Row-Level Security (RLS), audit logging, and data privacy.

•
Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with a demonstrated ability to align and influence global engineering, security, compliance, and executive stakeholders without direct authority.

What will give you an edge:

• Experience with Knowledge Graphs, ontologies, taxonomies, and enterprise entity resolution (MDM).

• Hands-on familiarity with headless BI, metric stores (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, Cube), or governed NL-to-SQL products.

• Domain background in payments, fintech, benefits, healthcare-adjacent platforms,

Your Impact

As an Axon CMM Metrology Programmer, you will perform dimensional and vision inspection and testing of incoming, in process, and finished product by using various measurement devices to ensure compliance with engineering specifications.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Hiya is seeking a Demand Generation Manager to lead full-funnel marketing programs that drive pipeline and revenue growth across our global enterprise and telecom segments. You’ll own the strategy, execution, and measurement of Hiya’s paid, digital, and campaign operations, ensuring every marketing dollar creates measurable impact.

You’ll connect channels, data, and insights to build a predictable demand engine that enables smarter investment, stronger alignment, and faster growth. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing, Sales, and external agencies to deliver integrated campaigns that convert interest into opportunities.

You’re an analytical, creative marketer who likes to roll up your sleeves and find new ways to meet marketing and sales targets. You care deeply about both the numbers and connecting with the humans inside each audience segment. You’re excited for how AI has transformed your way of working and look for new opportunities to build with AI every day.

- Attribution and reporting: Own Hiya’s ROI reporting, connecting spend to pipeline and revenue through clear, consistent reporting.

- Agency management: Partner with demand agency to optimize budget allocation, creative testing, and media performance.

- 4-6 years in demand generation, growth marketing, or performance marketing for a B2B SaaS company

- Proven success driving measurable pipeline and ARR through multi-channel campaigns

- Ability to translate data into strategy, and strategy into cross-functional action

- Documented experience building AI tools to enable or augment demand workflows; curiosity for where AI can support a fast-growing demand function

- Deep understanding of digital acquisition (Google, LinkedIn, Programmatic) and funnel analytics

- Strong eye for ad creative, with experience providing clear creative briefs and constructive feedback

- Hands-on comfort with Salesforce, HubSpot, and analytics tools

- Strong project management and prioritization skills in fast-moving environments

description:
THE POSITION :

The Project Accountant, Deployment Billing and Contract Revenue, will support Deployment billing, contract administration, revenue recognition, deferred revenue review, and project setup activities for complex client contracts. This role will analyze Statements of Work, amendments, pricing exhibits, and billing provisions to ensure contract terms are translated into accurate project setup, billing requirements, revenue treatment, and recurring operational controls. The position will partner with Project Accounting, Deployment Operations, Sales Operations, FP&A, HR, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Legal / Contract Management, and IT / Power Platform resources to improve billing readiness, reduce key-person dependency, and strengthen revenue integrity.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

• Review SOWs, amendments, pricing schedules, rate cards, and related contract documents to identify billing-relevant terms, required data inputs, approval requirements, exceptions, and renewal or escalation provisions.

• Translate contract terms into billing requirements, project setup instructions, recurring invoice support needs, revenue recognition considerations, deferred revenue requirements, and audit support documentation.

• Apply accounting judgment and working knowledge of ASC 606 revenue recognition concepts to support appropriate revenue treatment, including identification of performance obligations, timing of revenue recognition, variable consideration, contract modifications, and required documentation.

• Support deferred revenue analysis, reconciliations, release schedules, and period-end review to ensure revenue is recognized in accordance with contract terms, company policy, and applicable accounting guidance.

• Create, maintain, and validate project setup information in D365 or related ERP systems, including project contracts, project IDs, billing rules, funding sources, contract lines, invoice formats, rate structures, and required billing metadata.

• Partner with business owners to obtain required operational inputs, including rosters, vacancies, hires, terminations, recruiting activity, salary information, bonus activity, cost model assumptions, amendments, and CRM updates.

• Maintain contract terms registers, billing requirements trackers, responsibility assignments, approval records, issue logs, and supporting documentation.

• Prepare or support monthly and quarterly billing, revenue, deferred revenue, accrual, reconciliation, and close activities related to Deployment contracts.

• Research and resolve contract interpretation, billing setup, invoice support, revenue recognition, and data ownership issues in collaboration with Finance, Operations, Legal, Sales Operations, HR, Payroll, FP&A, and IT.

• Support process documentation, template development, testing, training materials, and continuous improvement efforts related to Deployment billing readiness and contract term management.

Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben. Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet Dir die Türen für anspruchsvolle Projekte mit einzigartigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Werde Teil einer der besten und verlässlichsten Beratungen und nutze vielfältige Entwicklungschancen. Als engagiertes Teammitglied kannst Du bei uns schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und über Dich hinauswachsen. Du triffst auf ein starkes Team, das zusammenhält und wirklich etwas bewegen will. Ziel der Position Als Communications Manager gestaltest Du aktiv die externe Unternehmenskommunikation von cbs und trägst dazu bei, unsere Sichtbarkeit, Positionierung und Reputation im Markt nachhaltig auszubauen. Du entwickelst relevante Themen und Stories, übersetzt komplexe Inhalte in überzeugende Kommunikation und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Expertise, unsere Projekte und unsere Persönlichkeiten bei den relevanten Zielgruppen sichtbar werden. Was Dich erwartet Corporate Communications: Du konzipierst und realisierst Kommunikationsmaßnahmen zur Stärkung der Positionierung, Sichtbarkeit und Reputation

description:
Sales Recruiter
Join a fast-paced, people-first team as an on-site Sales Recruiter. We value energetic, driven recruiters who can move quickly and deliver great candidate experiences while filling B2B sales roles.
 
What you'll do
• Source, screen, and close candidates for sales and business consulting roles (B2B sales profiles).
• Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and deliver qualified pipelines with minimal ramp-up time.
• Manage full-cycle recruiting from outreach and interviews through offers and onboarding.
• Maintain clear candidate communication and a strong sense of urgency in a results-oriented environment.
 
Who we're looking for
• High-energy, proactive recruiter currently working in recruiting or recently impacted by a layoff and ready to contribute from day one.
• Minimum of three years of recent recruiting experience with demonstrated success filling sales or B2B roles.
• Experience recruiting sales profiles, business consultants, or similar B2B sales positions.
• Previous sales or business consulting experience is a plus.
• Industry experience with companies such as Paychex, Paylocity, or Paycor is preferred but not required.
 
Location & schedule
• This is an on-site opportunity. Available locations: Chandler, Miami, Duluth, Deerfield, Troy, and Charlotte.
• Standard schedule: 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.
 
Why you'll like working here
• A collaborative, fast-moving environment where experienced recruiters are empowered to own their pipelines.
• Opportunity to work closely with sales leadership and influence hiring outcomes.
We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. If you meet the core qualifications and are excited to hit the ground running, we want to hear from you.

title: Java Developer – Big Data Processing
description:
About the role
We are building the next generation of large-scale recommendation and personalization platforms that power data-driven experiences across multiple business domains.
As a Senior Java Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of distributed systems, high-volume data processing, and production machine learning. This role is designed for engineers who thrive in complex environments, enjoy solving deep scalability challenges, and want to influence architecture and engineering excellence at scale.
You will play a key role in bridging data science innovation with reliable production systems, enabling high-performance ML pipelines and resilient microservice architectures that serve millions of users.
What you'll do

• Design, develop, and maintain high-performance backend services using Java and Spring Boot

• Build and optimize large-scale data processing pipelines using Apache Spark and Spark SQL

• Contribute to the architecture and implementation of distributed systems and data-driven platforms

• Collaborate closely with data scientists and ML engineers to productionize machine learning models

• Develop and maintain high-scale recommendation and personalization engines

• Ensure clean, maintainable, and well-tested code, applying best practices and design patterns

• Improve system performance, scalability, and reliability in enterprise production environments

• Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to long-term platform evolution

• Support orchestration and automation of data workflows

• Mentor engineers and promote strong engineering standards within the team

What we're looking for

• Strong hands-on experience with Java and backend engineering

• Solid knowledge of design patterns, clean code principles, and software architecture

• Proven experience building and operating distributed systems

• Strong experience within the JVM ecosystem

• Practical experience with Big Data processing, including: Apache Spark, Spark SQL

• Mandatory experience working in enterprise-level production environments

• Experience building scalable backend platforms and microservices

• Strong problem-solving mindset and ownership attitude

Nice to have

• Experience deploying machine learning models in production environments

• Knowledge of Python

• Experience with Apache Airflow for data orchestration

• Understanding of A/B testing methodologies

• Exposure to AWS SageMaker

• Experience with cloud-based data platforms and ML pipelines

Perks and benefits

• Private medical insurance

• National holidays off, even when falling on weekends

• Loyalty leave: +1 day/year

• Continuous professional development opportunities

• Sports subscription programs

• Referral bonuses for bringing in new talent

• Meal tickets

• Bookster subscription for reading & learning

• Community and team-building events

• Flexible and unlimited remote work policy
