title: Principal Engagement Manager, AI
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken https://kraken.tech/ powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 WHERE YOU'LL FIT IN:

THE ROLE IN A NUTSHELL

While our Sales Directors focus on the initial "Land"- introducing our agentic AI offering to our clients and securing the first use case - you are the architect of the "Expand."

Your mission is to take a client who has seen the initial spark of value and guide them toward full-scale AI transformation. You aren't just managing a relationship; you are building the business cases that prove why we should handle their most complex customer journeys, from home moves and complaints to high-volume storm responses.

WHY THIS ROLE IS UNIQUE

You aren't starting from zero. You are taking over accounts that already love the product and have seen it work. Your job is to take that 20% success story and turn it into a 100% partnership. You are the bridge between a successful start and a transformative future.

🚀 WHAT YOU’LL OWN:

1. STRATEGIC ACCOUNT EXPANSION

- Partner with the Sales Director during the hand-off to deeply understand the client’s initial pain points and long-term vision.

- Identify white space within the account - finding new conversation types and new channels where Agent Studio can drive ROI.

- Move the needle from a "pilot" or "niche" implementation to a core, enterprise-wide solution.

2. BUSINESS CASE & ROI DEVELOPMENT

- Act as a value consultant. Clients will want proof before they commit more budget; you will gather data from their initial deployment to build compelling, CFO-ready business cases.

- Translate technical performance (e.g., containment rates, sentiment analysis) into business outcomes (e.g., cost savings, CX improvements, reduced churn).

3. RELATIONSHIP & STRATEGY MAPPING

- Build deep, multi-threaded relationships across the client’s organisation - from the operational leads to the C-Suite.

- Understand the client’s 12-to-24-month roadmap to ensure Agent Studio is positioned as the primary tool to solve their upcoming challenges.

4. SOLUTION ADVOCACY

- Conduct innovation workshops with clients to showcase how new Agent Studio features can solve specific business problems they haven't yet addressed.

- Act as the internal voice of the customer, feeding back requirements to the Product team to ensure our roadmap aligns with enterprise growth.

🧠 WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE PARTY:

- You have a background in account management, customer success, or strategic consulting where your success was measured by revenue growth.

- You are comfortable diving into spreadsheets and analytics to find the proof that justifies a client’s further investment.

- You can take a complex AI product and explain its value in terms of business outcomes rather than just features.

- You have extensive experience working with autonomous AI products and understand the technical complexity behind the customer outcomes.

- You can juggle deep diving into multiple customers accounts and strategies in parallel without becoming unorganised.

- You know how to navigate complex corporate hierarchies and build trust so that you are seen as a long term partner in their strategy.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Senior Product Designer
LONDON / PRODUCT & DESIGN / FULL-TIME
Theodo UK builds digital products with cross-functional teams of engineers and product managers embedded directly with clients. Until now, design support mostly came from other entities in the Theodo group.
As our UK projects grow in complexity and ambition, we want to build stronger design capability locally. And for that, we are looking for our first Senior Product Designer in the UK.
Someone hands-on enough to solve real product problems day-to-day, but also able to help shape how design evolves inside the business.
You’ll work directly with the leadership team, product teams and engineers to design digital products, facilitate discovery work, support pitches and improve how teams build products together. This is a highly visible role.
You will help clients solve complex UX and UI challenges while also helping Theodo UK grow its design capability internally.
What You’ll Work On
At Theodo UK, designers are not isolated from delivery.
You’ll work inside cross-functional product teams alongside engineers and product managers to:

Solve UX and UI challenges on digital products
Facilitate discovery workshops and product discussions
Translate business problems into user-centred experiences
Design interfaces that are pragmatic, scalable and implementation-ready
Contribute to pitches, prototypes and strategic client conversations
Help teams make better product decisions

Projects can range from:

Early-stage MVPs
Scaleup product redesigns
Internal operational tools
Mobile applications
Complex B2B platforms
Discovery and innovation work

You’ll also help improve how design is embedded within Theodo UK itself.

title: Distributed Systems Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

About Ritual 

Ritual is building a sovereign, execution layer for AI, with our private testnet already live and running. The Ritual chain is the first blockchain custom-built to support AI-native operations, designed from the ground up to enable a new class of applications at the intersection of crypto and AI. Our first product, Infernet, is pioneering new ground as the first solution to enable developers to access AI models both on-chain via smart contracts and off-chain, demonstrating our commitment to bridging these transformative technologies.

About the role

As a Distributed Systems Engineer at Ritual, you'll be instrumental in building and scaling our heterogeneous blockchain infrastructure. You'll work on innovative solutions for node specialization, consensus mechanisms, and distributed AI execution while ensuring the reliability and performance of our network.

• Design and implement distributed systems components for Ritual's heterogeneous compute network

• Develop and optimize peer-to-peer networking protocols optimized for AI model execution and blockchain consensus

• Build and maintain infrastructure for node monitoring, metrics collection, and system observability

• Architect solutions for efficient state management and synchronization across specialized nodes

• Collaborate with the research team to implement novel distributed systems algorithms

• Create robust testing frameworks for distributed system components

About you

• Deep expertise in Go and/or Rust, with a track record of building production-grade distributed systems

• Strong understanding of peer-to
